name: link-button
title: LinkButton
description: Inline text that shimmers as you hover, then navigates like a link. Secondary CTAs inside paragraphs or cards.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Type and padding scale of the inline link control.
configurables.how: default for body copy; sm/xs for dense meta; lg/xl for hero links. Default: default.

configurables.what: Prevents navigation and dims the link.
configurables.how: Prefer removing the link over a dead disabled style when possible. Default: false.

configurables.what: Whether the shimmer / text-swap motion runs on hover.
configurables.how: true for marketing CTAs in body; false in dense legal lists. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Requires a real href for keyboard and screen readers; do not fake links with onClick only.
children must be a string for animated text-swap paths.

agent.usage:
import { LinkButton } from '@/components/atoms/LinkButton';

<LinkButton href="/docs" size="default" animated>
  Read the docs
</LinkButton>
